idea-plugin.name: Gruvbox Archipelago
idea-plugin.description:
Gruvbox Archipelago brings the warm, retro-groove palette of Gruvbox to modern JetBrains IDEs, with first-class support for the Islands UI.

Four themes are included:

  • Archipelago Dark — Gruvbox dark with the modern Islands layout.
  • Archipelago Light — Gruvbox light with the modern Islands layout.
  • Mainland Dark — the classic flat dark layout, without islands.
  • Mainland Light — the classic flat light layout, without islands.

Based on the editor schemes from Vincent Parizet's MIT-licensed Gruvbox Theme, refreshed for IntelliJ Platform 2025.3+ and the Islands UI, with full UI and editor-scheme coverage for modern JetBrains IDEs.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • Initial release with Archipelago Dark/Light and Mainland Dark/Light.
  • Canonical Gruvbox palette across the UI and editor schemes.
  • Islands UI support plus classic flat variants.
